title: Support contact fixes and sharper header logo

requirements.summary: Update the Support UI phone contact to +254 723169783 and render it as a tel: link.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the Support UI shows a "Phone Support" entry with the exact number "+254 723169783".
Clicking/tapping the phone number uses a tel: link that initiates a call to +254 723169783 on supported devices/browsers.

file_operations.description: Replace the placeholder phone number with the exact display value "+254 723169783" and ensure the anchor uses a valid tel: href (e.g., a sanitized digits-only variant) while keeping the visible text exactly as specified.

requirements.summary: Ensure the Support drawer visibly contains a Customer Support contact list and is reachable from both header and footer triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: From the header "Support" button, the Support drawer opens and displays the support contacts list.
From the footer "Customer Support" button, the Support drawer opens and displays the support contacts list.
The Support drawer contains at least one contact item labeled in English (e.g., "Phone Support") and includes +254 723169783.

file_operations.description: Confirm the drawer content clearly presents a visible English-labeled contact list section (including "Phone Support") and that it includes +254 723169783 (displayed) to satisfy the required minimum contact item.
Verify the header "Support" control opens the Support drawer reliably (via the existing trigger element) and keep the behavior consistent for both desktop and mobile menus.
Verify the footer "Customer Support" control opens the Support drawer reliably (via the existing trigger element).
Confirm the SupportDrawer is mounted in the shared layout so the drawer and its trigger are present across pages where header/footer are rendered.

requirements.summary: Improve header logo sharpness at 40x40 rounded display while keeping the same asset path reference in Header.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: When displayed in the header at 40x40 with rounded corners, the logo appears crisp (not blurry/pixelated) at normal zoom and on high-DPI screens.
No code changes alter the logo image path used by `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` (it must continue to reference `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`).

file_operations.description: Replace the existing generated logo file with an improved sharpness/clarity version while keeping it a 512x512 PNG and keeping the exact same filename and location.

Keep the logo src path exactly "/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png" but adjust rendering attributes/classes as needed (e.g., explicit width/height, fitting mode) to avoid browser blur when shown as a 40x40 rounded icon.
